verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Notion serves an llms.txt at developers.notion.com/llms.txt that indexes its docs as Markdown (.md) pages, and the cited guides are also served as .md files. A machine-readable openapi.json is also available, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing llms.txt/agent-doc usage, independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.notion.com/llms.txt # Notion Docs
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://developers.notion.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
